title: Did Early Humans Keep Souvenirs 500,000 Years Ago?
paragraphs: Many people keep small things from a trip, like a stone or a ticket. These things help them remember a place or a day.

Researchers from Tel Aviv University think early humans did this too, about half a million years ago. In Qesem Cave in Israel, people brought small colourful pebbles into the cave. The stones had no clear use.

In another place, the Sakhnin Valley, people made stone axes from flint that had fossils inside. The scientists say this is only an idea, not proof. They think such objects may have helped early humans remember their own experiences.
